To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the lichen diversity of the study area is low, the similarity index is high and the similarity indices are related to the fir percentage and the altitude difference.
the Sørensen similarity index values of lichen species ranged between 0,29 and 0,84.
the similarity indices of lichens in the study area are related with the species number, the average similarity index and the altitude difference of the sites.

the investigation of lichen species and their similarity indices in Serif Yuksael forest, Turkey.

the study of the lichen populations and the similarity analysis of the lichen species in the Serif Yuksel National Forest, which is one of the important forests of Turkey in terms of lichen diversity.

the lichen species diversity is high, and the species number is low in the pure fir stands.
the similarity indices of lichens are affected by many factors and it is difficult to make a clear and general conclusion.
the similarity indices of lichens in pure fir forests are higher and that the similarity indices are lower in the lichen communities of the sites where fir is not the dominant species.

the lichen population in the pure fir stands of the forest are more similar than those in the mixed stands and the pure fir stands.
the species number of lichen population is the most important parameter to determine the similarity index.
the lichen species in the pure fir stands are more diverse and the similarity indices of the sites are higher than the other stands.
